question: Should outbound recovery keep ambiguous entries pending with backoff when no reconciliation-capable adapter is available, instead of moving them to failed?
rationale: Tests can prove either behavior, but the choice affects operator visibility, upgrade behavior, and how long ambiguous message-delivery rows remain pending before the broader delivery ledger exists.

options.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
options.body: After the no-op pacing fix and green exact-head validation, merge the mitigation so ambiguous no-adapter rows stay recoverable while the broader ledger remains tracked separately.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep current main's terminal failed behavior until adapter reconciliation or operator surfacing is ready.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a doctor, UI, or API surface before changing ambiguous entries to remain pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
recommendation.body: After the no-op pacing fix and green exact-head validation, merge the mitigation so ambiguous no-adapter rows stay recoverable while the broader ledger remains tracked separately.
